title: chore(deploy): pin stable Files widget portal
body:
Pins the immutable Portal API/frontend images built from open-suite-portal merge `6d094166c61a3178b428e8f0d0cb8d3b2352f73b` (`sha-6d09416`). That merge removes the incorrect one-use Direct Editing launch path from the Files widget and restores durable `/f/{id}` navigation. Updates convergence to require the exact Portal pair.

No other image or deployment behavior changes.

Parent investigation: https://ampcode.com/threads/T-019f775a-2eb5-71f8-8061-21a600ed65e2
